text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Starting today! Training!!
I'll be in your careeee, pleeeaaase!!
choice_data_list: Let's do our best together!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!! I'll put my everything into whatever training we do,
so just tell me what to do!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but didn't you want to talk first before we got moving?
What is it, what is it? What should we talk about?

Before diving into full-blown training, I wanted to get
to know her better and make sure we both understood where she stood.

According to the materials from the academy instructor
who oversees the unassigned horsegirls in group training—
choice_data_list: Do you tend to rush and get overexcited during races?
Do you tend to rush and get overexcited during races?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aaaahhh! People tell me that all the time!!
I've been trying to fix it, but it's just so hard...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I mean, everyone gets so fired up in a race, right? When that fierce vibe
and the 'WOOOO!' energy hits me, I just can't help it...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, the academy instructor told me,
'You're far too honest with your emotions.'

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Is that really true, though?
Seems totally normal to me.
choice_data_list: ...Have you heard of "60,000 Furlongs in Search of Mother"?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The one where Umako's the main character, right?! I totally know it!
I watched the anime!! And read the novel in our school textbook!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That story was soooo good, wasn't it?! In episode 1, when Umako
picked up the carrot that little girl dropped... Man, that just...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... *sob*... Umakooo, you're the besttt!!
You're such a good girrrrrl!!
choice_data_list: Yep, you're definitely honest to a fault!
Yep, you're definitely honest to a fault!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat?!

Indeed, her brutally honest, full-throttle nature
might currently be a weakness for Winning Ticket. However—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer?!?
You're deep in thought... Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me... Could it be...
Is this a really, really bad thing about me?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
UWWWAAAAHHH!! Making my Trainer worry like this...
What's wrong with me... What kind of girl am I?!
choice_data_list: There's nothing bad about it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
B-But in the Debut Selection, I got swept up
by the atmosphere and ended up fifth...
choice_data_list: No, your personality will become a powerful weapon someday.
No, your personality will become a powerful weapon someday.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Really?!
A weapon... I see, so that's how it is...!!

Being able to pour your heart out honestly
can become a lethal weapon once you learn when and where to unleash it.

Which means what Winning Ticket needs right now is the ability
to judge those critical moments—in other words, 'calculated running.'
choice_data_list: Alright, Ticket! I know what we need to do!
Alright, Ticket! I know what we need to do!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oooooh! What is it, what is it?!
choice_data_list: It's study time!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Stu... dy...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
G-GWWWWWAAAAAHHHH?!
WHAAAAAAT DID YOU SAYYYYYYY?!

...And with that, our days of arduous trials
with Winning Ticket officially began.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
DORRYAAAAAAAHHH!!
...Phew!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how was that?!
I gave it everything I had!!
choice_data_list: This is pace training, so you have to look at the clock...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The clock...? Huh?!?
O-OH RIGHTTTT, I FORGOTTTTT!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, let me try one more time!!
TOOOOO-YAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Run it in one minute... Run it in one minute...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh?
Is hitting this point at 20 seconds too slow? Or too fast?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
U-UWWWAAAAAHHH!!
I HAVE NO IDEEEAAAAA!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ummm, the reason the favorite lost
in that last race was...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah! She didn't train hard enough!!
If you give it your all, everything works out!! More training is the only answer!!
choice_data_list: Can you think of anything else...?
Can you think of anything else...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Anything else?! Any... other... reason...?!
choice_data_list: She cut too close to the inside on the turn and got boxed in.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Aaaahhhhhhh!
NOW THAT YOU MENTION IT!

As expected, thinking things through logically wasn't exactly
her strong suit, making our training quite a rough road.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*knock knock knock*
Excuse meeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I watched tons of the race footage you lent me yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And look, I wrote down how I think I should run,
so please take a look right now!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I know it's late, but is it okay?
choice_data_list: Of course! Giving it your all today too, I see.
Of course! Giving it your all today too, I see.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You bet I am!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I always give it my all, but... somehow, how do I say this,
I feel like the 'full power' inside me is getting way, way bigger!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
'Cause Trainer, you really mean it, right?
—That we're gonna win the Derby together!
choice_data_list: Of course. We made a promise, after all.
Of course. We made a promise, after all.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!! I can feel loud and clear
that you've believed in me all this time!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer believes in me! Just knowing that gives me
so much more power than I've ever had before!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: So with that said... Please check it out!!

Though the road was rocky, Winning Ticket tackled everything
with all her might, and the potential for her growth was undeniably real.
If it's her, I know she can evolve...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! How was it?!
My notebook!!
choice_data_list: ...Alright, let's think through this together one more time!
...Alright, let's think through this together one more time!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: NOOOOO WAYYYYYYY?!
...Surely, probably, absolutely!
